name: cityhall
title: cityhall
blurb: a sim city with no god mode: you get one council seat, a policy deck, and six factions (landlords, tenants, the chamber, the green coalition, nimbys, the police union) who all have real votes. run a full term, see who ends up loving you and who's plotting your recall. riffs on @dollspace.gay's 'sim city but with actual political constraints' pitch, asked for by @faz.ms.
